decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product that has remained on its own webpage since 2023, it carries visible commitment and sunk development effort, so management is likely to persist with it unless results clearly collapse.

Although it received a dedicated webpage, this orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's stated customer base and strategic direction, so with only limited accumulated commitment management is comparatively more likely to exit it.

This post-curing unit fits the firm's digital production trajectory and core offer, and even with more limited public commitment than a standalone page, management can still justify giving it more time.
